# Records of processing and transfers

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @suskii/api privacy:records` from
     apps/api/src/privacy/processing-records.ts and data-registry.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

What Suskii processes, why, on which basis, for how long and who receives it (ADR-089). The
NDPA, the Kenya Data Protection Act and POPIA expect a controller to be able to show this; the
GDPR calls it the record of processing activities (Art. 30). Locations come from the
providers' public terms: confirm each against the terms the owner signs.

- **Controller:** Suskii Travels and Tours (legal entity, registration numbers and the data
  protection officer to be named by the owner; see `docs/compliance/privacy-obligations.md`).
- **Hosting:** Google Cloud, London (europe-west2), behind Cloudflare (ADR-059).
- **Security:** field encryption, TLS everywhere, staff MFA and audit (`docs/security/`).
- **Rights:** self-service export and deletion, staff-recorded requests with deadlines per law
  (`docs/runbooks/data-rights-requests.md`).

## Activities

### Accounts, sign-in and security

Create and protect accounts: sign-in, MFA, sessions, devices, staff roles and the audit log of security-relevant actions.

- **Lawful basis:** Contract: needed for the service the person asked for; Legitimate interests: security, fraud prevention and service quality
- **People:** Travellers with an account; Suskii staff; Drivers and driver applicants; Bus operator agents
- **Data:** Names, dates of birth, nationality; Email addresses and phone numbers; Password hashes, authenticators, session tokens; Push tokens, hashed IP addresses, device attestation
- **Recipients:** Google Cloud (Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager); Cloudflare (edge, WAF, Turnstile); Email relay (SMTP); SMS provider; Apple App Attest, Google Play Integrity; Sentry

| Table | Retention | On account deletion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `User` | While the account exists; deletion applies its treatment | redact |
| `UserRole` | While the account exists; deletion applies its treatment | delete |
| `Session` | Retention sweep `sessions`: 30 days after the event | delete |
| `RefreshToken` | With its Session | delete |
| `MfaFactor` | While the account exists; deletion applies its treatment | delete |
| `MfaRecoveryCode` | While the account exists; deletion applies its treatment | delete |
| `SocialIdentity` | While the account exists; deletion applies its treatment | delete |
| `DeviceCredential` | Retention sweep `device-credentials`: 30 days after the event | delete |
| `VerificationToken` | Retention sweep `verification-tokens`: 7 days after the event | delete |
| `AuditLog` | Kept: append-only, ids, amounts and reasons only | retain |
| `IdempotencyKey` | Retention sweep `idempotency-keys`: as soon as it expires | delete |

### Bookings and trip fulfilment

Quote, book, ticket and change flights, hotels, packages, tours and add-ons; send documents; handle airline changes and cancellations.

- **Lawful basis:** Contract: needed for the service the person asked for
- **People:** Travellers with an account; Guests who book without an account, and the passengers they name
- **Data:** Names, dates of birth, nationality; Email addresses and phone numbers; Passport details and visa documents; Itineraries, bookings, tickets and vouchers
- **Recipients:** Google Cloud (Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager); Cloudflare (edge, WAF, Turnstile); Duffel, and the airlines and hotels it books; Hotelbeds, and the hotels it books; Expedia Rapid, and the hotels it books; Email relay (SMTP); Expo push service (to FCM and APNs)

## Recipients and transfers

Who receives personal data, where it processes it and the basis for sending it abroad.
"Not contracted" recipients run on mock adapters until the owner signs up; nothing is sent.

| Recipient | Role | Receives | Location | Transfer basis | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Google Cloud (Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager) | processor | Every stored record and file (hosting) | United Kingdom (europe-west2, London; ADR-059) | Processor terms with transfer safeguards (the provider's data processing terms, signed by the owner) | live |
| Cloudflare (edge, WAF, Turnstile) | processor | Requests in transit: IP address, browser details, request content | Global network (the data centre nearest the visitor) | Processor terms with transfer safeguards (the provider's data processing terms, signed by the owner) | live |
| Duffel, and the airlines and hotels it books | processor | Passenger names, dates of birth, contact and passport details for the booked trip; airlines and hotels receive them as independent controllers | United Kingdom; then the airline's or hotel's country | Needed to perform the booking or payment the person asked for (NDPA ss. 41 to 43, Kenya DPA s. 48, POPIA s. 72) | optional (`FLIGHT_SUPPLIERS, HOTEL_SUPPLIERS`) |
| Hotelbeds, and the hotels it books | independent controller | Guest names and the booker's contact details for the booked stay | Spain; then the hotel's country | Needed to perform the booking or payment the person asked for (NDPA ss. 41 to 43, Kenya DPA s. 48, POPIA s. 72) | optional (`HOTEL_SUPPLIERS`) |
| Expedia Rapid, and the hotels it books | independent controller | Guest names, the booker's contact details and the checkout IP address for the booked stay (ADR-086) | United States; then the hotel's country | Needed to perform the booking or payment the person asked for (NDPA ss. 41 to 43, Kenya DPA s. 48, POPIA s. 72) | optional (`HOTEL_SUPPLIERS`) |
| Paystack, Flutterwave, Stripe | independent controller | Email address, amount and our reference; card details are entered on their pages only (SAQ A) | Nigeria (Paystack, Flutterwave); United States and Ireland (Stripe) | Needed to perform the booking or payment the person asked for (NDPA ss. 41 to 43, Kenya DPA s. 48, POPIA s. 72) | optional (`PAYMENT_PROVIDERS`) |
| Email relay (SMTP) | processor | Email address and the message | Depends on the relay the owner picks | Processor terms with transfer safeguards (the provider's data processing terms, signed by the owner) | not contracted (`SMTP_URL`) |
| SMS provider | processor | Phone number and the message (sign-in codes, alerts) | Depends on the provider the owner picks | Processor terms with transfer safeguards (the provider's data processing terms, signed by the owner) | not contracted (`SMS_PROVIDER`) |
| Expo push service (to FCM and APNs) | processor | Push token and the notification text (in-app paths only, no booking details) | United States | Processor terms with transfer safeguards (the provider's data processing terms, signed by the owner) | live |
| Meta WhatsApp Cloud API | processor | The traveller's WhatsApp number and support messages (ADR-084) | United States and Ireland | Processor terms with transfer safeguards (the provider's data processing terms, signed by the owner) | not contracted (`WHATSAPP_SUPPORT_PROVIDER`) |
| Meta Conversions API, TikTok Events API | independent controller | SHA-256 of the normalised email and phone, click ids and the Purchase value, only with marketing consent | United States and Ireland (Meta); Singapore, United States and Ireland (TikTok) | Consent recorded before anything is sent (marketing consent, ADR-079) | not contracted (`AD_CONVERSIONS`) |
| Anthropic Messages API | processor | Scrubbed trip descriptions (AI trip search) and scrubbed support messages with booking facts but no names, contacts or references (ADR-061, ADR-085) | United States | Processor terms with transfer safeguards (the provider's data processing terms, signed by the owner) | optional (`AI_SEARCH_ENABLED, SUPPORT_ASSISTANT_ENABLED`) |
| Sentry | processor | Error events with ids and scrubbed messages; no IP addresses (ADR-046) | United States or Germany (the data region the owner picks) | Processor terms with transfer safeguards (the provider's data processing terms, signed by the owner) | not contracted (`SENTRY_DSN`) |
| Apple App Attest, Google Play Integrity | independent controller | Attestation tokens from the app (no account data from us) | United States | No personal data is sent | live |
| Driver identity check (KYC) provider | processor | A driver's NIN, licence number and photo | Depends on the provider the owner picks | Processor terms with transfer safeguards (the provider's data processing terms, signed by the owner) | off in production (`CARS_RIDES_ENABLED (ADR-069)`) |
| Driver payout provider | processor | A driver's bank account details and the amount | Depends on the provider the owner picks | Processor terms with transfer safeguards (the provider's data processing terms, signed by the owner) | off in production (`CARS_RIDES_ENABLED (ADR-069)`) |
| Travelpayouts and Viator | independent controller | A click id as sub_id; the traveller books on the partner site under its own terms (ADR-070) | Not applicable | No personal data is sent | optional (`PARTNER_OFFERS_ENABLED`) |

## Coverage

All 74 tables that hold personal data belong to an activity above;
the other 49 hold reference or operational data only.
